name: Necker Island
positioning: All-inclusive private island in the North Sound of the British Virgin Islands, ringed by coral reefs and white sandy beaches, with Balinese-style houses, resident wildlife and endless water sports
best_for: Groups and families who want a whole island to themselves
Active travelers who want water sports and tennis, padel and pickleball on hand
Travelers who want an all-inclusive stay where food, drinks and activities are covered

facts.text: Necker Island is situated in the North Sound of the British Virgin Islands, in the eastern Caribbean Sea.
The island sits in turquoise waters surrounded by coral reefs and fringed with white sandy beaches.
Stays are all-inclusive, covering all food and drinks, activities and water sports.
Bedrooms and common areas channel Indonesian temples, with intricately carved wooden ceilings, zen gardens and stone Buddhas.
The hilltop Great House has far-flung views of the waters around the island.
The onsite spa, Samudra, offers facials, massages, scrubs and Sodashi skincare treatments.
There is an infinity pool pavilion with a hot tub and a swim-up bar.
Guests can use tennis, padel and pickleball courts, with a dedicated on-island tennis professional for lessons and coaching.
Guests can feed the island's lemurs with one of the keepers on site.
Floating sushi boats served at the pool pavilion are a Necker tradition.
Stays include a return boat transfer from Virgin Gorda or Beef Island airports.
A Kids Club runs a curated programme of activities for younger guests.

highlights.text: With exclusive hire, Necker Island is yours alone: no other guests and no shared spaces.
The island is home to resident lemurs, and flamingos gather at their pond.
Rooms feature airy bedrooms, sun-drenched terraces and infinity pools.
Water sports include snorkelling, paddleboarding, kayaking, Hobie sailing, e-foiling and seabobbing.
A boat trip to the Virgin Gorda Baths, with granite boulders and hidden rock pools, can be arranged.

considerations.text: Individual rooms or suites can be booked only on select dates each year; at other times the island is hired exclusively.
The minimum stay on Necker Island is four nights.
The island is not very accessible because of its steep hills.
